meta.title: Vendor rejects the counter offer — buyer QCS shows rejected tag
warnings: resolved: “Reject the pending counter offer in the supplier portal as the vendor.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow for the RFQ event.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the RFQ pricing sheet can be completed.
Fill the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a bidding schedule.
Invite one vendor to receive and answer the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit the invited vendor's original bid, which is required before sending a counter offer.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the vendor bid.
Send a buyer counter offer to the vendor.
Confirm the counter offer is marked as initiated for the vendor.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round where the pending counter offer should be available.

args.need: reject the pending counter offer in the supplier portal as the vendor

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor-side reject-counter-offer action.
Return to the buyer's QCS after the vendor rejects the offer.
Reopen the buyer's RFQ Master QCS to inspect the counter-offer outcome.
Assert that the vendor's QCS tag shows the rejected counter-offer result.
